message: I was reversing out of my apartment garage in Kalyani Nagar on 2026-11-08 when I scraped a concrete pillar. The rear quarter panel and tail lamp of my insured car MH12CD4821 are damaged. Nobody was hurt and the car is safe to drive. Policy number MTR-4821-P. The workshop quoted Rs 31500. I have not filed a police report.

Please open a claim for my insured car KA03NE6412. A loose metal sheet fell from a building site in Jayanagar on 2026-11-09 and dented the bonnet and roof. No one was injured. The vehicle can still be driven. Policy MTR-KA-6412. Repair estimate is approximately 68,000 rupees. The police have not been contacted.

My car HR26DK7315 was damaged by a falling branch outside Cyber Hub, Gurugram. The windscreen is intact but the bonnet and front grille need replacement. This happened on 2026-11-10. Nobody was injured, and the car is roadworthy. Policy number POL-HR-7315. The garage estimate is Rs 42,700. No FIR has been filed.

An e-rickshaw reversed into my parked car DL8CAX2906 near Lajpat Nagar market on 2026-11-11. My front bumper is cracked and the radiator is leaking; the car cannot be driven safely. The e-rickshaw driver was not hurt and no other property was damaged. Policy ID CAR-2906-DEL. Estimate from the service centre: Rs 54,000. I have not registered a police complaint.

I need to report an accident involving my insured vehicle TN09CQ5180 and a school bus at Adyar on 2026-11-07. The bus driver's wrist was injured and an ambulance took him for treatment. My policy is TN-MOTOR-5180. The bus has a damaged side panel. We do not have a repair estimate yet. An FIR was registered at the Adyar station.

On 2026-11-06 my insured car TS08FG2044 rolled into a neighbour's gate on Road No. 12, Banjara Hills. The gate is bent and the neighbour has asked us to pay for repairs. Nobody was injured. My policy number is HYD-2044-77 and my own car repair estimate is Rs 9,800. The neighbour and I exchanged details but did not file a police report.

My insured vehicle WB06RZ8831 was involved in a collision at Howrah Bridge approach on 2026-11-05. A passenger travelling in my car, who is not the policyholder, has a cut above the eye and received stitches. The other car's door is also damaged. Policy WB-MOT-8831. Police filed a report. The repair bill is not available yet.

A delivery rider's motorcycle was damaged when my insured car GJ01HT6620 rolled backwards at a signal in Navrangpura on 2026-11-04. The rider says the handlebar is bent, but nobody was injured. My policy number is GJ-6620-INS. My car's repair estimate is Rs 7,250. Both parties exchanged phone numbers; no police report was filed.

My insured hatchback MH46BL9017 is missing from the basement parking of our office in Airoli. I parked it there after work yesterday and the access logs show no exit. Please register this as a suspected vehicle theft under policy NVI-9017. I have informed the security desk but have not approached the police. The vehicle's value is not known.

expected.location: basement parking of our office in Airoli

message: Someone broke the steering lock and took my motorcycle KA05LP7732 from the lane behind my house in Basavanagudi on 2026-11-03. I have lodged an FIR and received acknowledgement number 214/2026. Policy number BIKE-KA-7732. No one was injured. The insured value is Rs 78,000.

expected.location: lane behind my house in Basavanagudi

message: The infotainment unit and both headlamps were removed from my parked car RJ14VM3368 at a hotel lot in Udaipur during the night of 2026-11-02. The car itself is still there. Policy RJP-3368. I reported the theft to the police and a written complaint has been accepted. No one was hurt. Replacement parts are expected to cost Rs 96,500.

I cannot find my car UP16QJ4402 after leaving it in the visitor parking at our apartment in Noida last evening. The guard checked the cameras and says it was not moved by residents. I suspect it has been taken. Policy UP-MTR-4402. I called the police control room, but no FIR or written report has been made yet.

expected.location: visitor parking at our apartment in Noida

message: A fire destroyed my insured van MH20KP5519 at our storage yard in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on 2026-11-01. The assessor has confirmed that the vehicle is beyond economical repair. No one was injured. Policy COMM-5519. The estimated loss is Rs 8,40,000. The fire brigade attended, but no police report was filed.

My car PB10XZ6124 was swept into a canal near Ludhiana on 2026-10-31. The recovery team retrieved it, but the chassis is twisted and the surveyor has declared it a total loss. The driver escaped without injury. Policy PUN-6124. Insured loss estimate: Rs 5,75,000. A police report was filed at the nearby station.

There was a collision on the bypass outside Kochi on 2026-10-30. My insured SUV KL07MN8246 hit a divider and rolled over. The cabin is crushed and the insurer's assessor says it cannot be repaired. The co-driver suffered a broken leg. Policy KER-8246. Estimated loss is Rs 11,20,000. The police registered an FIR.

My insured taxi MH09TR1183 was hit by a train at an unmanned crossing near Kolhapur on 2026-10-29. The vehicle body is torn apart and the surveyor has confirmed it is beyond repair. The driver and all passengers escaped without injury; no bystanders were hurt. Policy TAXI-1183. The loss is assessed at Rs 6,30,000. Police filed a report.

A stone flew off a construction truck and cracked only the front passenger window glass of my car MH02WV6108 near BKC on 2026-11-12. There is no damage to the body or any other part. Policy GLASS-6108. The replacement quote is Rs 19,600. No one was injured.

Only the driver's side window of my car TN10AB7391 was shattered by a falling coconut outside our home in Coimbatore on 2026-11-13. The door and frame are undamaged. Policy TN-GL-7391. The glass shop quoted 4,300 rupees. Nobody was hurt and I did not contact the police.

The rear quarter glass on my insured vehicle AP09CF5520 cracked while it was parked at a shopping centre in Vijayawada on 2026-11-14. All metal panels and the windscreen are fine; this is a glass-only loss. Policy AP-5520. Expected replacement cost is Rs 8,900. No injuries were reported.

Claim intimation: my car MH31YU2085 has a crack across the front windscreen after a pebble struck it on the Samruddhi Expressway on 2026-11-15. No other damage is present. Policy MTR-2085. Replacement estimate Rs 12,750. Nobody was injured; no FIR was registered.

Hello, I am comparing comprehensive and third-party motor insurance plans before buying a policy. Could you explain what add-on covers are usually available? I have not purchased a policy and no accident has occurred.

I submitted a motor claim last week under policy CAR-55602 and would like to know whether the surveyor has uploaded the inspection report. No new accident has happened; I am only asking for the status of the existing claim.

Good afternoon. I need a duplicate copy of my vehicle insurance certificate for a loan application. The policy reference is BANK-MTR-2406 and the registration is MH14QX2406. There has been no loss, theft or accident; this is only a document request.
